proof_checks: Reconstructed the theorem on the full matrix space; linearity uniquely extends M_Q from the q>0 region to all matrices.
Verified that at q=0, the specified probability Tr(M_Q(rho)) = 0 combined with the positivity of M_Q(rho) strictly forces M_Q(rho) = 0.
Verified that subtracting M_Q(rho) = Q rho Q from C(rho) = Q rho Q + rho_uu pi_p uniquely leaves M_u(rho) = rho_uu pi_p.
Verified complete positivity (M_u has a single Kraus operator |p><u|) and trace preservation (Q^2 + |u><p|p><u| = Q + pi_u = I).
Verified all sixteen matrix-unit identities, confirming the linear extension holds for arbitrary valid coherences.
Verified both canonical preparations: Q probabilities are 3/5 and 4/5, conditional parent populations are 1/3 and 1/4, complementary branch is pi_p, and total P1 parent populations are 3/5 and 2/5.
Verified all rejecting controls: the original pinching instrument has branch rho_uu pi_u (not pi_p), and changing it requires the u -> p reset action.
Confirmed no other two-outcome CP instrument satisfies the exact all-input contract due to the strict uniqueness of M_Q and M_u.
Distinguished the theorem from weaker contracts: more than two outcomes only fixes the sum of complementary branches, and restricted-state equality allows off-diagonal freedom.
Confirmed the result legitimately removes the requirement that conditioning equal pushforward by demonstrating their compatibility as a joint instrument.
Verified the text explicitly avoids inserting an event typing, reset action, outcome law, receiver, access relation, or physical probability interpretation, maintaining them as supplied premises.
